== Sources and status (4 November 2026) ==
* Bill asked (4 November 2026) for pages for cards printed on Players Committee slip sheets but missing from the PC card lists, the wiki and GEMP, after checking whether the PC blanked them.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf VirtualBlock3.pdf] (official text 7 December 2009; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Preserved copy], sha256 checked) prints the slip. Its header has no removal or change note (compare VirtualBlock6_1.pdf, which notes that Rebel Fleet (V) was removed).
* Not on the PC [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html Virtual Block 3 card list] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181927/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html Preserved copy]) or on the PC Virtual Master list (VMaster.html, checked live 4 November 2026). No PC notice blanking or withdrawing it was found in the later Virtual Block PDFs (6.1 to 8.2).
* The PC still hosts a full card image for it under cards/legacy/VirtualBlock3-Light/ (checked live 4 November 2026); it is not uploaded here yet.
* No GEMP id: the card is not in GEMP.
* The game text matches [[Captain Verrack (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm)]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf VirtualBlock8_2.pdf] (14 September 2012; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Preserved copy]) prints a different Captain Verrack (V), now [[Captain Verrack (V)]]; it gives no note about the Block 3 card.
* Rarity: no PC list gives one, so it is left out. Icons are the two shown on the slip (Pilot, Warrior).
